title: Chapter 310 The First Desperate Situation
content:
Chapter 310 The First Desperate Situation

At the same time, huge fighting sounds came from the bronze palace deep in the ancient battlefield.

Rumble!

"Young Master Xiao, we have given you a chance. Since you don't leave, don't blame us for being rude!"

The man with a slightly pale face stared at Xiao Luo in the distance and spoke coldly.

At this time, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were both seriously injured and stood in the distance and persisted hard.

Shortly after entering the Bronze Palace, they met Chen Mingyu and others without any surprise.

When the enemies meet, they are extremely jealous.

Lu Xue and others naturally rushed up directly while Chen Mingyu and others were not paying attention.

However, the strength gap between the two sides is a bit huge.

Just when Chen Mingyu reacted, they instantly fell below.

"Xiao Luo, do you really think I dare not kill you because of the background of the Xiao clan?"

Chen Mingyu held a silver spear and pointed at Xiao Luo in the distance, and spoke with murderous intent.

The voice was cold, like the King of Hell in the underworld.

A terrifying killing intention continued to overflow from Chen Mingyu's body.

Seeing this, the people around him suddenly felt a stern.

The boss is angry.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo spitted blood and looked at Chen Mingyu with contempt. There was no fear in his eyes, but it was full of anger.

"Stop talking nonsense, just beat me if you want to fight. Why don't there be so much nonsense? Chen Mingyu, do you really think I'm afraid you won't be able to do it?"

Xiao Luo's arrogant words echoed from the bronze palace.

Anyone who hears it will be angry.

At this moment, Chen Mingyu smiled.

Just a smile is very creepy.

At this time, the murderous intent that overflowed from Chen Mingyu's eyes was almost about to turn into substance.

"Brother Yu, killing him may be bad for us."

The stunning woman suddenly appeared beside Chen Mingyu and grabbed Chen Mingyu's hand.

This made Chen Mingyu frown slightly.

He knew that Luo Qingshui was telling him that the Xiao clan would not give up with them.

After all, although they look down on Xiao Luo, Xiao Luo is also the only young man in the Xiao clan who can show off now.

If Xiao Luo is really killed, I am afraid that even if the Xiao clan pays all the price, he will kill them.

At that time, let alone his reputation on the list of monsters, it may not be easy to call out his ancestors.

Thinking of this, Chen Mingyu held the silver spear a little tighter.

"Since you can't kill Xiao Luo, then kill the other few."

"So what about Tiandi Academy? If you can't control your own students, you can't blame me."

As he said that, Chen Mingyu suddenly pointed the spear in his hand at Qin Feng, Lu Xue and others.

"Nine-clawed Dragon, I will give you a chance. Be my fairy beast, and I can spare you."

Looking at Ao Qing in the distance, Chen Mingyu said coldly.

There was a hint of greed in his eyes.

This is the legendary dragon monster, and its future prospects are limitless.

It would be a pity if I just killed it like this.

Hearing Chen Mingyu's words, Ao Qing snorted coldly and said disdainfully: "Go to be your dream of spring and autumn. You are worthy of it?"

Seeing Ao Qing ungrateful, Chen Mingyu looked cold and rushed towards Ao Qing directly.

"Xiaoqing is careful!"

laugh!

Lu Xue slashed out with a sudden sword, and an ice phoenix condensed by the sword intent immediately turned towards Chen Mingyu with a terrifying coldness.

However, this only blocked Chen Mingyu for a moment.

The next moment.

There was a loud bang.

Ao Qing's huge body was directly bombarded onto the bronze wall, causing a buzzing sound.

"Xiaoqing!"

Seeing this, Lu Xue's eyes were slightly red and she rushed towards Ao Qing.

"Hmph, this is the price of disobeying me."

"As for you, don't worry, your fate will be the same as this dragon soon."

Chen Mingyu looked at Lu Xue beside Ao Qing, with the murderous intent in his eyes not concealed at all.

Because at the beginning, Lu Xue attacked him the most fiercely.

A beautiful mural carved above the end of this corridor.

It seemed to contain some supreme truth, which made him deeply attracted to the mural just after taking a look.

However, just as he was intoxicated by it and understood the mystery, a long sword emitting extreme cold almost pierced into his neck.

It's like shit is suddenly forced to be pinched off.

This makes him not angry.

At this time, Lu Xue turned a deaf ear to Chen Mingyu's words and just hurriedly checked Ao Qing's injuries.

Fortunately, Ao Qing has thick skin and no fatal injuries.

But it's still very serious.

The gap between the two sides is too big.

Perhaps they can only fight against Chen Mingyu by working together.

However, looking at the four pairs of eyes around him, Lu Xue felt a little desperate.

It was all her fault for being impatient for a moment, which made them suffer such a desperate situation.

What should I do now?

Watching Chen Mingyu walk slowly towards him.

The silver spear with murderous intent was dragged to the ground by Chen Mingyu and kept splashing sparks.

"In the next life, don't be enemies with me."

"Sister Xue!"

Seeing this, Qin Feng and the others were extremely anxious.

But at this moment, the other four people were entangling them and not giving them any chance.

"Damn, do you know who she is? If you dare to do anything to her, you will definitely die!"

Xiao Luo knew that he would be finished when he was holding it in such a situation, and then roared quickly.

Not far away, Qin Feng frowned slightly, but immediately stretched out.

It's almost gone, so how could I care about so much.

"Xiao Luo is right. Her identity is not simple, you can't kill her."

Hearing this, the four of them couldn't help but laugh.

But looking at Xiao Luo and the others' serious faces, it seemed that they were not joking.

This made the few people suddenly start to think.

yes.

Can the existence that can make the nine-clawed dragon recognize the master be an ordinary person?

Moreover, that woman was only in the Immortal Lord Realm, and she didn't even have the Immortal Saint Realm, but her combat power was able to catch up with such powerful people as the Immortal Emperor Realm.

If Chen Mingyu hadn't been there, they would have been unable to do anything to Lu Xue.

More importantly, these people are following Lu Xuema's head, not Xiao Luo.

So, the woman's identity background is even more terrifying than that of the Xiao clan.

For a moment, several people hesitated.

In the distance, Chen Mingyu immediately sneered when he saw the faces of several people who were afraid of them.

"You can scare others, but you can't scare me."

"So what if her identity is not simple? This is an ancient battlefield. I want to kill it, no one can stop it."

As he said that, Chen Mingyu raised his spear and stabbed Lu Xue and Ao Qing with a sudden shot.

In an instant, the dazzling gun lighted up the entire corridor.

In the huge corridor, Lu Xue and others seemed very small.

"My master, go quickly."

At this time, Ao Qing spoke weakly.

But at this time, Lu Xue slowly stood up and stared at Chen Mingyu in the distance with an extremely cold expression.

"If you want to kill me, it depends on your ability."

Buzz —

The Xuanyuan Sword burst out with a deafening sound of sword.

At this time, the Xuanyuan Sword seemed to have come back to life, and the sword kept ringing.

Looking at the Xuanyuan Sword in his hand, Lu Xue knew that this was the first time that Xuanyuan Sword had recognized him.

That kind of real recognition.

The next moment, Lu Xue rushed directly towards Chen Mingyu and stabbed him with a sword.
